confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded estimates from crowdsourced and secondary price sources (Numbeo-style indexes, a French cost-of-living site, UK and Turkish travel guides), with sources disagreeing by roughly 1.5x to 2x; the Turkish lira is volatile, so these July 2026 figures may not hold. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Marmaris resort-town seasonality in July and were not checked against live listings. Beer and coffee are at the midpoint of several sources. Cocktail was set from the beer price using a bar-to-beer ratio of about 2.3x, because direct Marmaris cocktail data was weak. Wine was set from Turkish resort wine-glass reports, adjusted down for Marmaris. The FX observation is from an 18 November 2026 search result attributed to the RBA homepage and a secondary site; I could not open the RBA F11.1 table directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a Turkish Aegean resort town. Food and drink are benchmarked against Turkish resort and Istanbul price reports and Numbeo-style Marmaris figures. Accommodation is benchmarked against typical summer resort pricing for mid-sized Turkish Mediterranean and Aegean towns. Region is assigned to Middle East because Turkey is conventionally grouped there in this taxonomy.
